title: Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.34435v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning

translated_title: 大部分已经就绪：将强大的视频先验转化为动作条件化世界模型
translated_abstract: 现代视频生成器擅长在文本和图像提示的引导下生成视觉上可信的未来画面。然而，它们对语义合理性的强调并不能保证对特定动作的物理后果的忠实呈现。相比之下，动作条件化世界模型（ACWM）旨在模拟世界如何响应机器人动作，从而无需昂贵的真实世界部署即可实现可扩展的策略评估与改进。挑战不仅在于生成一个合理的未来，而在于预测特定物理动作将会产生的结果。随着视频先验日益强大，我们提出的问题是：弥合这一差距究竟需要多少适配？我们提出Dianjing，这是一个极简方案，通过统一的物理动作条件化、将训练集中于决定运动与布局（进而决定动作后果）的高噪声水平、以及原生的历史条件化，来保留并释放强大视频先验的固有能力。
tldr: 该论文提出Dianjing这一极简适配方案，通过统一物理动作条件化、聚焦高噪声阶段的训练以及原生历史条件化，将强大的视频生成先验高效转化为可用于机器人策略评估的动作条件化世界模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dianjing, a minimal adaptation recipe that turns a strong video prior into an action-conditioned world model through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at high noise levels, and native history conditioning.
